description: This file defines helper mixins and classes for fixed and sticky positioning, including responsive variants for different breakpoints.

classes.name: fixed-top
classes.description: Helper class for a fixed element positioned at the top of the viewport.

classes.name: fixed-bottom
classes.description: Helper class for a fixed element positioned at the bottom of the viewport.

classes.name: sticky#{$infix}-top
classes.description: Responsive sticky positioned element at the top, variant depending on breakpoint.

classes.name: sticky#{$infix}-bottom
classes.description: Responsive sticky positioned element at the bottom, variant depending on breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-up
methods.description: Mixin to apply styles at or above specified breakpoint.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Function to generate infix for breakpoint-specific class names.
